name: suprema-proxy
description: Production-ready proxy server for Suprema biometric devices with auto-start capabilities

scripts.build-secure: pkg src/secure-proxy.js --targets node18-win-x64 --output dist/suprema-secure-proxy.exe && node scripts/add-icon.js
scripts.restart: npm run stop && npm run start
scripts.status: powershell -Command "Get-Process -Name suprema-secure-proxy -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Id, ProcessName, StartTime"
scripts.generate-certs: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "& { $certDir = 'certs'; if (!(Test-Path $certDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $certDir }; openssl genrsa -out certs/localhost.key 2048; openssl req -new -x509 -key certs/localhost.key -out certs/localhost.crt -days 3650 -subj '/C=US/ST=CA/L=San Francisco/O=Suprema Proxy/OU=Biometric/CN=localhost' -extensions v3_req -config <(echo '[req]'; echo 'distinguished_name = req'; echo '[v3_req]'; echo 'subjectAltName = @alt_names'; echo '[alt_names]'; echo 'DNS.1 = localhost'; echo 'DNS.2 = 127.0.0.1'; echo 'IP.1 = 127.0.0.1') }"
scripts.package-production: npm run build-production && npm run copy-assets
scripts.copy-assets: xcopy certs production-deployment\certs\ /E /I /Y && if not exist production-deployment\logs mkdir production-deployment\logs
scripts.clean: rmdir /s /q dist logs 2>nul || echo Clean completed
